import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;

    static long sumModulo(long a, long b) {
        return (a + b) % MOD;
    }

    static long subtractModulo(long a, long b) {
        a -= b;
        return (a < 0) ? a + MOD : a;
    }

    static long multiplyModulo(long a, long b) {
        return (a * b) % MOD;
    }

    static long powerModulo(long base, long exp) {
        long result = 1;
        long cur = base % MOD;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                result = multiplyModulo(result, cur);
            }
            cur = multiplyModulo(cur, cur);
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }

    static long modularInverse(long x) {
        return powerModulo(x, MOD - 2);
    }

    static int nSize2;
    static List<long[]> A2;
    static long[][][] T_table2;
    static List<Map<Long, Long>> DP_states2;
    static int[] familyCount2;
    static int[] familyId2;
    static List<List<Integer>> familyMaskList2;

    static void initialize() {
        familyMaskList2 = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i <= nSize2; i++) {
            familyMaskList2.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
        for (int mask = 1; mask < (1 << nSize2); ++mask) {
            int count = Integer.bitCount(mask);
            familyCount2[mask] = count;
        }
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << nSize2); ++mask) {
            int count = familyCount2[mask];
            familyId2[mask] = familyMaskList2.get(count).size();
            familyMaskList2.get(count).add(mask);
        }
        T_table2 = new long[nSize2 + 1][1 << nSize2][1 << nSize2];
        for (int k = 0; k <= nSize2; ++k) {
            for (int i = 0; i < familyMaskList2.get(k).size(); ++i) {
                int cm = familyMaskList2.get(k).get(i);
                for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << nSize2); ++mask) {
                    long ans = 0;
                    if ((mask & cm) == mask) continue;
                    for (int x = 0; x < nSize2; ++x) {
                        if ((cm & (1 << x)) != 0) continue;
                        if ((mask & (1 << x)) == 0) continue;
                        int newmask = cm | (1 << x);
                        ans |= (1L << familyId2[newmask]);
                    }
                    T_table2[k][i][mask] = ans;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        nSize2 = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
        A2 = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < nSize2; ++i) {
            String[] parts = br.readLine().split(" ");
            long[] row = new long[nSize2];
            for (int j = 0; j < nSize2; ++j) {
                long val = Long.parseLong(parts[j]);
                row[j] = multiplyModulo(val, modularInverse(100));
            }
            A2.add(row);
        }
        initialize();

        DP_states2 = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i <= nSize2; ++i) {
            DP_states2.add(new HashMap<>());
        }
        DP_states2.get(0).put(1L, 1L);

        for (int k = 0; k < nSize2; ++k) {
            Map<Long, Long> currentDP = DP_states2.get(k);
            Map<Long, Long> nextDP = DP_states2.get(k + 1);
            for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> entry : currentDP.entrySet()) {
                long mask = entry.getKey();
                long val = entry.getValue();

                long prob = 1;
                for (int i = 0; i < nSize2; ++i) {
                    if (((mask >> i) & 1) != 0) {
                        prob = multiplyModulo(prob, A2.get(k)[i]);
                    } else {
                        prob = multiplyModulo(prob, subtractModulo(1, A2.get(k)[i]));
                    }
                }

                for (int i = 0; i < familyMaskList2.get(k).size(); ++i) {
                    int familyMask = familyMaskList2.get(k).get(i);
                    if ((mask & (1L << i)) != 0) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    long newmask = 0;
                    long p = multiplyModulo(prob, val);
                    for (int j = 0; j < familyMaskList2.get(k).size(); ++j) {
                        if (((mask >> j) & 1) != 0) {
                            newmask |= T_table2[k][j][(int)familyMask];
                        }
                    }
                    if (newmask != 0) {
                        nextDP.put(newmask, sumModulo(nextDP.getOrDefault(newmask, 0L), p));
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(DP_states2.get(nSize2).getOrDefault(1L, 0L));
    }
}
